results.name: R13/P

results.name: R13/W

results.name: R13/M

results.name: R14/P
results.what: one VPMADDUBSW(PABSB(w), PSIGNB(x, w)) word == w0*x0 + w1*x1, |.| <= 32,512, any w, x in [-127,127]

results.name: R14/P x=-128
results.what: R14/P without DOM-ACT-Q (expect a counterexample: x = -128, w < 0)

results.name: R14/M
results.what: red8 of VPADDD(VPMADDWD(p0, 1), VPMADDWD(p1, 1)) == index-order sum of the 32 words, mod 2^32

results.name: R12/P
results.what: one VPDPBUSD lane (acc + 4 products, wrapping) == acc + the exact products; each |u*x| <= 32,385 under DOM-ACT-Q

results.name: R12/M
results.what: 4 chunked VPDPBUSD accumulations + lane total == index-order sum of the 16 four-product sums, mod 2^32

results.name: R15/M
results.what: sum (nx_i - 8 x_i) == sum nx_i - 8 * sum x_i, mod 2^32 (the bias rewriting with a.sum = sum x_i)

results.name: R16/M
results.what: sum (ux_i - 128 x_i) == sum ux_i - 128 * sum x_i, mod 2^32

results.name: R18/M
